figure.caption: Office network: wired and wireless access
figure.description: The Internet connects to an office firewall/router, then to a LAN switch. The switch connects to a Wi-Fi access point, wired PCs and a NAS. Wi-Fi laptops connect through the access point. Lines are bidirectional logical connections; no redundant uplink or guest-network isolation is shown.
